ModMetaData.name: Deep Colony
ModMetaData.author: azraelgodking
ModMetaData.description:
Your colonists are more than their stats. Seven systems — auto skill perks, trauma and therapy, apprenticeship, family, a living faction reputation ledger, and two optional ones: the body (contagion and convalescence) and the Codex (research notebooks and archives) — give the colony a history.
Deep Colony 2: one build for RimWorld 1.6 and one for 1.7, both updated together. Everything lives in one Deep Colony tab. Soft Multiplayer support (every player needs the host's Deep Colony settings). Works alongside Nemesis, Strata, Stormproof, Living World, Homesteader and Date Night; COMPATIBILITY.md in the mod folder lists every supported mod and DLC.
Requires Harmony. Safe to add mid-save. Older saves are cleaned up once on first load; keep a backup if you might go back to 1.10.
Full notes: https://azraelgodking.github.io/rimworld_mods/deep-colony Discord: https://discord.gg/Vwh2y7qMXv
